in_arabic.name: طوكل
in_arabic.long_meaning: الطوكل هو مصدر من أصول عربية يُشير إلى الثقة واليقين في الله، يُعتبر تعبيرًا عن التوحيد والتوكل على الله في جميع الأمور، ويُستخدم في القرآن الكريم حيث يقول الله تعالى "وَلَسَوْفَ يُؤَلِّفُ اللَّهُ الَّذينَ آمَنوا ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ "  (النمل 59). والطوكل يُعتبر اسمًا إسلاميًا شهيرًا في العالم الإسلامي، ويُستخدم كأول اسم في الأسماء الثلاثية.

in_urdu.name: طوکل
in_urdu.long_meaning: طوکل ایک عربي اصطلاح ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ پر بھروسہ کرنا، یہ توحید کا ایک پہلو ہے جس میں اللہ کو اپنا تمام بوجھ اوپر ڈال دیا جاتا ہے۔ اللہ کے بے پناہ رحمت سے انسانوں کو ہر مسئلے میں سہارہ ملتا ہے۔ اس کا ارادہ ہے کہ ہم سب کو اللہ کے سوا کچھ نہیں کرنے کی ضرورت ہے۔ اس سے انسانوں کو اللہ کی محبت اور ان کے ساتھ سلسلہ برقرار رکھنے کی تلقین کی جاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: टाव्केल
in_hindi.long_meaning: टाव्केल एक इस्लामी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है अल्लाह पर विश्वास करना, यह एक महत्वपूर्ण इस्लामिक अवधारणा है जो अल्लाह के प्रति विश्वास और आत्मविश्वास को दर्शाता है। इस्लाम के ग्रंथ कुरआन में कहा गया है, 'और अल्लाह ने वे लोगों को जोड़ने की योजना बनाई है जिन्होंने ईमान लाया है, अल्लाह बहुत मेहरबान और रहमदिल है' (अनीस 59)।

in_pashto.name: طوکل
in_pashto.long_meaning: طوکل یوځای د الله پر ایښودنه ده، چې د الله په پرتلو پر سپارلو او دا یو د الله پر ځانګړی ځای دى، دا هغه وخت کې راځي چې الله د خپل عطا په پرتلو پر سپاريږي، دا یو د الله پر بې پناہ رحمت سېنې، الله د خپلو پېروانو ته د خپل عطا په پرتلو پر سپاريږي او دا د خپلو پېروانو ته د دښمنو له لوري د خطرو په پرتلو پر سپاريږي.

in_english.name: Tawkeel
in_english.meaning: To trust and rely on Allah for all matters
in_english.long_meaning: Tawkeel is an Arabic concept that means to trust and rely on Allah for all matters, it is a fundamental aspect of Islam that emphasizes putting one's trust in Allah and having faith in His infinite mercy and compassion. The Quran states, 'And Allah will bring together those who have believed, and He will not let their deeds be lost (of anything)', (An-Nahl 59). Tawkeel is a popular Islamic name in the Muslim world, often used as the first name in triple naming.

data.cultural_impact: The Arabic term "Tawkeel" holds significant importance in Islamic culture as it signifies reliance, trust, and support. It is used in various contexts, including the legal realm, where it refers to the designation of a trustee to handle one's affairs when traveling or incapacitated. It is also used in everyday life, as a form of encouragement to lean on and trust in Allah, and in our relationships, as a reminder to support and assist one another.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the term "Tawkeel" holds immense significance as it is a reminder of our dependence on Allah, the Almighty. It encourages us to seek His support and trust in His mercy and guidance in times of need. This concept is also echoed in the famous du'a (prayer) of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) where he asks Allah to make him a source of succor and support for others. Thus, the word "Tawkeel" serves as a constant reminder of the interconnectedness of all beings and the importance of relying on and supporting one another while ultimately trusting and depending on Allah.

historical_references.reference: The concept of Tawkeel was first introduced by the Abbasid Caliph Al-Mansur in 754 AD during the construction of the Great Mosque of Kufa. It was a system of trust, whereby the caliph appointed an agent to represent him and manage the project on his behalf.
historical_references.context: Construction of the Great Mosque of Kufa

historical_references.reference: During the Fatimid Caliphate in Egypt (969-1171 AD), Tawkeel was used as a form of political power and control. Caliphs appointed governors as their agents to rule in their name, maintaining central authority and control over the provinces.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Islamic concept of Tawkeel, which refers to the delegation of authority or trust to another person, has gained modern significance in various sectors, particularly in the context of digital transformation, technological innovation, and online services. In e-commerce websites, customers can grant Tawkeel to trusted individuals or entities to manage their online purchasing and sales activities. In digital banking applications, Tawkeel is used to authorize transactions on behalf of account holders, ensuring security and convenience. In learning management systems, students can delegate authority to peers or mentors to monitor their progress and provide feedback, fostering a collaborative learning environment. Overall, Tawkeel is an essential concept in the digitally interconnected and technologically advanced world, enabling trust, delegation, and collaboration in various domains.
